_what_this_is: A pod that outlived its launcher. I killed the acquisition loop's tmux session to restart it after a code fix while attempt49's launcher was mid-flight; the kill took the launcher's whole process tree and its pod kept billing with no orchestrator. Found by a routine provider poll showing TWO live pods against a one-billing-resource contract, attributed by pod_id to the attempt whose launcher was gone, terminated directly, and confirmed absent by polling rather than by trusting the terminate call.
final_provider_state: terminated and confirmed gone; pods returned to 1
_no_measurement: no recovery training or measurement began; wasted engineering spend, not a scientific result
_lesson: never kill the acquisition loop while a launcher is mid-flight -- the loop already retries on its own
